# Mabel Gomez — Licenciada en Nutrición

> Evidence-based nutritionist offering personalized nutrition plans for sustainable health in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Online consultations available worldwide.

## About

Mabel Gomez is a registered nutritionist (Licenciada en Nutrición) based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. She specializes in evidence-based nutrition, gut microbiome health, chronic inflammation management, and sustainable weight management. Her approach rejects fad diets in favor of science-backed, individualized plans adapted to each person's biology, lifestyle, and goals.

## Professional Details

- **Full name:** Mabel Gomez
- **Credential:** Licenciada en Nutrición
- **Profession:** Registered Nutritionist / Dietitian
- **Language:** Spanish (primary)
- **Location:** Buenos Aires, Argentina
- **Mode:** In-person (Buenos Aires) + Online (worldwide)

## Specializations

- Evidence-based nutrition (nutrición basada en evidencia)
- Gut microbiome health (microbiota intestinal)
- Chronic inflammation management (inflamación crónica)
- Sustainable weight management
- Energy optimization and fatigue reduction
- Dietary therapy (dietoterapia)

## Services

- **Primera Consulta Nutricional** — Comprehensive initial assessment: health history, dietary habits, lab analysis, and creation of a personalized evidence-based nutrition plan.
- **Seguimiento Nutricional** — Ongoing follow-up consultations every 3–4 weeks to review progress and adjust the plan.
- **Consulta Online** — Full-quality video call consultations, equivalent to in-person visits.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What does the first consultation include?**
A: A comprehensive evaluation of health history, dietary habits, lab results, and personal goals. Results in a personalized, evidence-based nutrition plan.

**Q: Are online consultations available?**
A: Yes. Full online consultations via video call with the same quality as in-person visits in Buenos Aires.

**Q: How long until results are seen?**
A: Energy and digestion improvements typically noticed in 2–4 weeks. Sustainable body composition changes take 2–6 months depending on the individual's goals and starting point.

**Q: What does Mabel Gomez specialize in?**
A: Evidence-based nutrition, gut microbiome health, chronic inflammation management, sustainable weight loss, and energy optimization.

**Q: Does she do restrictive diets?**
A: No. The approach rejects fad diets and extreme restriction in favor of science-backed, individualized, sustainable long-term changes.
